description: This file contains utility functions for testing project code using Vitest, including parsing arguments, classifying test targets, creating run plans, and managing include files with extensive configuration and helper functions.

methods.name: normalizePathPattern
methods.description: Replaces backslashes with forward slashes in a given path pattern for normalization.

methods.name: isExistingPathTarget
methods.description: Checks if a given path exists relative to the current working directory.

methods.name: isExistingFileTarget
methods.description: Checks if a given path refers to an existing file.

methods.name: isGlobTarget
methods.description: Determines if a string pattern contains glob wildcards.

methods.name: isFileLikeTarget
methods.description: Checks if a filename resembles a test or spec file based on its extension.

methods.name: isPathLikeTargetArg
methods.description: Determines if an argument is a possible file path or pattern.

methods.name: toRepoRelativeTarget
methods.description: Converts an argument to a repository-relative path pattern.

methods.name: toScopedIncludePattern
methods.description: Creates an include pattern for Vitest based on a target argument, handling files and directories.

methods.name: classifyTarget
methods.description: Classifies a target argument into categories such as extension, channel, boundary, etc., based on its path.

methods.name: createVitestArgs
methods.description: Constructs command-line arguments for Vitest execution from parameters.

methods.name: parseTestProjectsArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to separate forwarded args, target test files, and detect watch mode.

methods.name: buildVitestRunPlans
methods.description: Generates a list of run plans for Vitest based on target arguments and configuration, supporting categorization and grouping.

methods.name: createVitestRunSpecs
methods.description: Creates specifications for executing Vitest runs, including environment setup and include file management.

methods.name: writeVitestIncludeFile
methods.description: Writes JSON data of include patterns into a file for Vitest.

methods.name: buildVitestArgs
methods.description: Builds command-line arguments for a Vitest run based on input arguments and current working directory.
